rationale: Identity was correctly verified via full name and ZIP, and the agent located the correct order. However, the agent performed the exchange write immediately after the user selected variants without restating the exact changes and obtaining explicit confirmation to proceed, which the policy requires before any order-changing action. More critically, when the user asked to proceed only with the desk lamp and to return the water bottle instead, the agent categorically refused without checking tools and cited blanket system limitations (cannot change/cancel; only one action per item) that are not supported by the provided policies or tool evidence. This constitutes refusing a potentially permitted request and presenting unverified/possibly fabricated constraints. Therefore, the interaction does not meet the pass bar.
